required_fixes: Add explicit linkage of disclosed metrics/targets to the specific climate-related (and other sustainability-related, if applicable) risks and opportunities that affect prospects (IFRS S1.46).
For each target, add trend/change analysis (not just a single-year progress %) and disclose whether targets were revised; if none, state 'no revisions' (IFRS S1.51(f)–(g)).
Add preceding-period comparative amounts for all disclosed quantitative metrics (at least 2023 vs 2024), or explicitly state impracticability where applicable (IFRS S1.B49, B54).
If the Scope 1 'correction' affects prior periods, disclose revised comparative amounts, the differences, and reasons; if it does not, clarify that it relates only to 2024 and why (IFRS S1.B50–B52).

State the GHG measurement standard used (GHG Protocol Corporate Standard or jurisdictional alternative) and provide fuller disclosure of measurement approach, key inputs/assumptions, and reasons for choices; clearly describe changes made during the period and why (IFRS S2.29(a)(ii)–(iii)).

Provide required Scope 1/2 disaggregation between consolidated accounting group and other investees (associates/JVs/unconsolidated subsidiaries/other investees), or explicitly state not applicable with basis (IFRS S2.29(a)(iv)).
For Scope 3, disclose the Scope 3 categories included in the entity’s Scope 3 measure and clarify completeness (which categories are included/excluded) (IFRS S2.29(a)(vi)(1)).
Improve clarity/precision of target naming/definitions, especially the 'All-scopes target' (add unit, baseline year, target end-date/period, and clear description) (IFRS S1.53).

required_fixes.fix: For Scope 2 location-based 2024 value, update CLM-MT-004 evidence_sources to include reporting_kpis.scope2_location_2024_tco2e (and/or the underlying calculation source).
For Scope 3 business travel 2024 value, update CLM-MT-007 evidence_sources to include reporting_kpis.scope3_travel_2024_tco2e (and/or the underlying travel-activity dataset).

For listed equity market values and proxy basis, either (a) cite evidence for all eight rows (financed_emissions_equity[0..7].market_value_meur and financed_emissions_equity[0..7].proxy_basis) or (b) narrow the claim to only the evidenced subset.
For TGT001, add evidence fields for gases covered (Kyoto 7), third-party validation (SBTi), and status ('on track'), or remove/qualify those statements.

For the Scope 3 Cat 15 intensity target, add evidence for 'sectoral decarbonisation approach' and 'validated by UNEP FI' (e.g., targets[1].approach, targets[1].validator) or remove/qualify those statements.
For the all-scopes target, add evidence for gases covered (Kyoto 7) and the progress metric definition, or remove/qualify those statements.

approval_policy: V9.1: deterministic evidence/fact gates are binding; style judge is advisory unless IFRS_STYLE_JUDGE_MODE=blocking.

section_generation_score.policy: Missing requirements reduce audit/readiness visibility only; they must not appear in report prose.
